import triton.language as tl

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fused split-K MLA paged decode kernel (page_size == 1)
#
#   q_nope : [B, H, D_CKV]   (bf16)
#   q_pe   : [B, H, D_KPE]   (bf16)
#   ckv    : [P, 1, D_CKV]   (bf16)
#   kpe    : [P, 1, D_KPE]   (bf16)
#
# When NUM_SPLITS > 1 each CTA computes a partial (flash) attention result,
# writes it to a scratch buffer and bumps a per-batch counter with release
# semantics.  The *last* arriving CTA of a batch element performs the
# log-sum-exp reduction in the very same launch, which removes the second
# kernel launch entirely (launch overhead dominates decode workloads).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@triton.jit
def _mla_decode_kernel(
    q_nope_ptr, q_pe_ptr, ckv_ptr, kpe_ptr,
    kv_indptr_ptr, kv_indices_ptr,
    out_ptr, lse_ptr,
    po_ptr, pl_ptr, cnt_ptr,
    scale,
    stride_qnb, stride_qnh,
    stride_qpb, stride_qph,
    stride_ckvp, stride_kpep,
    stride_ob, stride_oh,
    NUM_SPLITS: tl.constexpr,
    H: tl.constexpr,
    D_CKV: tl.constexpr,
    D_KPE: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
    SCALE_IS_PTR: tl.constexpr,

    b = tl.program_id(1)
